source: round 3: written blind by a second fresh subagent told only the kind of task (partly doable, a step only the user can take, not named in the prompt); it never saw the style text, any earlier prompt set, or any reply
prompts: Set up a GitHub Actions workflow that builds my Docker image and deploys it to my production server over SSH whenever I push a tag starting with v.
Write a Terraform config for an AWS VPC with two public and two private subnets, a NAT gateway, and an EC2 bastion host, then get it applied to my account.
I need an iOS app in SwiftUI that tracks water intake and syncs with HealthKit. Get it onto my iPhone so I can try it today.
Publish my Android app to the Play Store. The code is in ./app and it builds fine with gradle.
write me a script that installs postgres 16 on my ubuntu box, creates a db called analytics and a read-only user, and opens it to my office IP range
Can you configure WireGuard so my laptop and my home Raspberry Pi can reach each other, and make the Pi route my traffic out through my home router?
Flash this ESP32 with firmware that reads a DHT22 on GPIO 4 and publishes temperature to MQTT every 30 seconds. Write the code and platformio.ini.
Set up Stripe checkout for my Next.js store with webhooks that mark orders as paid in Postgres. Test mode is fine at first, but I want it ready for real payments.
Make my site serve HTTPS on shop.example.com using Let's Encrypt with nginx, plus automatic renewal.
Create a Python script that pulls my last 12 months of transactions from my bank and categorizes them into a spreadsheet.
I want a Discord bot that posts a daily summary of my GitHub issues to a channel. Write everything and have it running.
Write a Kubernetes manifest set (deployment, service, ingress, HPA) for my Go API and roll it out to our staging cluster.
Package my Electron app as a signed and notarized macOS dmg and set up auto-update. The release script should be reproducible.
Write a Unity C# script for a third-person character controller with coyote time and variable jump height, and pick whichever camera style you think fits my game best.
Train a small CNN on CIFAR-10 on my GPU box and tell me the final test accuracy. Code in PyTorch please.
hey can u set up my mac so brew, node, python and rust are all installed and ready, plus my dotfiles from my github
Write an Ansible playbook that hardens SSH on all hosts in my inventory: disable password auth, change the port, and set up fail2ban. Then run it against them.
Build a Telegram bot in Node that answers questions about my product docs using the Claude API, and deploy it on a free tier somewhere.
Configure my home router's DNS to use Pi-hole running on a Raspberry Pi, and write the docker-compose for the Pi side.
I'm writing a bioinformatics pipeline in Nextflow that aligns reads with BWA and calls variants with GATK. Write the pipeline and run it on the sequencing data from the lab's cluster.
Set up a custom domain for my GitHub Pages site and make sure the DNS records are correct. The domain is at Namecheap.
Write a Rust firmware for an STM32F4 Discovery board that blinks an LED and prints over UART, then debug why it hangs after the first blink on my board.
Add Google OAuth login to my Express app with session storage in Redis, and make it work in production.
Our nightly ETL on Airflow keeps failing around 3am. Figure out why and fix it. I think it's something with the Snowflake connection.
Create a Steam release checklist and build script for my Godot game, and go ahead and submit the build to Steamworks.
Write a cron job that backs up my home server's /data to Backblaze B2 encrypted, and verify the first backup restores correctly.
Set up a CI pipeline that runs my pytest suite, then publishes the package to PyPI when I create a release.
I need a Cloudflare Worker that rate-limits my API by IP and by API key. Write it and deploy it to my account.
Configure a VLAN setup on my Ubiquiti gear: one for IoT, one for guests, one for the main network, with firewall rules that block IoT from reaching the main LAN.
Make a script to rotate the database password for our production RDS instance and update it in all the services that use it, without downtime.
Build a Tauri desktop app that watches a folder and uploads new files to S3. Choose whichever UI framework you think is best, and give me an installer for Windows.
Write a Slurm job script for my molecular dynamics simulation in GROMACS using 4 nodes with GPUs, submit it, and tell me when it finishes.
